route_note: Threat INI / data cartridge marks the SA-10 prebrief targets and CAP/fallback geometry.
deck_structure: Treat packages 3465 and 3494 as one integrated game plan and one briefing deck.

packages.briefing_read: Primary SEAD/DEAD package. Cyborg 1 attacks the newly identified SA-6 north of Joule and SA-10 West; Jackal 2 attacks SA-10 East and SA-10 South while Cobra 2, Cajun 1, and Cobra 4 protect the package.

sad_contracts.contract: SEAD/DEAD SA-6 North of Joule and SA-10 West
sad_contracts.intent: Work from Joule, destroy the SA-6 north of Joule first if it is factor, then prosecute SA-10 West. Confirm positive destruction of each target before egress.

sad_contracts.contract: SEAD/DEAD SA-10 East and SA-10 South
sad_contracts.intent: Work from Crown, prosecute SA-10 East and SA-10 South, and confirm positive destruction of both targets before egress.

cap_contracts.intent: Protect Cyborg 1 during the Joule-side SA-6 and SA-10 West prosecution.
Protect Jackal 2 during the Crown-side SA-10 prosecution.
Hold the northern flank against fighters arriving from the north-northeast.

target_opportunities.label: SA-6 N
target_opportunities.name: SA-6 north of Joule
target_opportunities.intent: Close SA-6 threat north of Joule; Cyborg 1 should kill this before or while working SA-10 West.

target_opportunities.label: SA-10 W
target_opportunities.name: SA-10 West
target_opportunities.intent: Western SA-10 threat in the data cartridge; Cyborg 1 primary target after the SA-6 is handled.

target_opportunities.label: SA-10 E
target_opportunities.name: SA-10 East
target_opportunities.intent: Eastern SA-10 threat in the data cartridge; Jackal 2 primary target from Crown.

target_opportunities.label: SA-10 S
target_opportunities.name: SA-10 South
target_opportunities.intent: Southern SA-10 threat in the data cartridge; Jackal 2 primary target from Crown.

packages.fallback_logic: If either SEAD flight becomes pressured, drag enemy fighters toward Tiger, the friendly SAG/Burke air-defense umbrella near common STPT 3. Cyborg 1 should prioritize survival and confirmation on the SA-6/SA-10 West targets; Jackal 2 stays focused on SA-10 East/South unless retasked.

slide_notes.commander_context: Cyborg 1: Joule-side SA-6 north of Joule, then SA-10 West. Jackal 2: Crown-side SA-10 East/South. Cobra 2 protects Cyborg, Cajun protects Jackal, Cobra 4 holds northern flank BARCAP.
slide_notes.positive_id: Both SEAD flights must confirm target destruction before calling the SA-10 threat neutralized.

packages.briefing_read: F-15C east-flank fighter screen. Intercept Flankers/Fulcrums from the east and shipborne Flankers coming off the ocean before they can pressure the SEAD package.

cap_contracts.intent: Push east, commit on Flanker/Fulcrum groups threatening the SEAD package, and sanitize the ocean-side axis.
Support Hog 5 and engage shipborne Flankers or other fighters flowing toward the SA-10 prosecution area.

target_opportunities.label: East Flank
target_opportunities.name: Flanker/Fulcrum threat axis
target_opportunities.intent: F-15C package should engage Flankers/Fulcrums from the east/ocean axis and any fighters pressing the SEAD package.

packages.fallback_logic: If the fighter picture becomes saturated, drag east-flank threats west toward Tiger, the friendly SAG/Burke air-defense umbrella, and the package BARCAPs.

slide_notes.commander_context: Hog 5 and Ramrod 3 are player F-15C BARCAP/intercept flights east of Crown. Their job is to kill Flankers/Fulcrums before those aircraft can reach the SEAD package.

friendly_surface_defense.name: Tiger - Friendly SAG / Burke umbrella
friendly_surface_defense.label: TIG
friendly_surface_defense.description: Tiger marks the friendly surface action group with an Arleigh Burke and two escorts near the common STPT 3 area. Use as a fallback/drag option if overwhelmed by enemy fighters.
friendly_surface_defense.intent: Do not brief as a primary threat; brief as a friendly fallback air-defense anchor.
